TRANSITION PROVISIONS. The transition from the 2 use of motor vehicle registration plates on both the front 3 and rear of certain vehicles to the use of such plates on 4 only the rear of certain vehicles, as directed by this Act, 5 shall be accomplished in stages. A person applying for a new 6 or replacement registration plate on or after the effective 7 date of this Act shall receive only one registration plate. 8 Otherwise, the transition shall not be accomplished until a new 9 series of registration plates is issued to replace a current 10 series. A person who was issued a pair of registration plates, 11 including special registration plates, may attach only one 12 plate in accordance with this Act on and after the effective 13 date of this Act.
